accept_criteria: Boundaries cover the full interview timeline without large unexplained gaps
Each boundary has valid start_ms/end_ms or segment_id aligned with transcript timing
Cut points respect natural turn boundaries and topic shifts
Shard batches collectively cover all time ranges when decomposed
reject_patterns: Partial boundaries with truncation_flags and no shard plan
Boundaries that split mid-sentence without editorial justification
Empty boundaries list when transcript has substantive content
